summary: Grace Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting receipt of FDA Type A meeting minutes regarding a Complete Response Letter for its GTx-104 NDA. The FDA identified no clinical safety or efficacy deficiencies and requested no additional clinical data; issues relate to cGMP compliance at a contract manufacturing organization, leachables data, and excipient toxicology assessments. The company plans NDA resubmission, including a dual-source manufacturing strategy. This is a routine regulatory update, not a special situation; no deal terms are involved.
